dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the deal with this warehouse?

dialogues.speaker: Habachi
dialogues.text: As the name indicates, this is where we store goods that fall under the public trust here in Aaru Village. There's nothing else to be said about it.

dialogues.speaker: Habachi
dialogues.text: But if you keep asking me these questions, don't blame me for suspecting you of ulterior motives.
